features.title: A planned 100-day programme, phase by phase, with a place for each session

Listen with eyes open or closed, with pause and resume and the screen off
Rate how calm you feel before and after a session, kept on your device
Optionally share the two calm numbers anonymously
See where you have been on the island map and revisit earlier sessions
Use it comfortably on a phone, by keyboard or screen reader, with a transcript for every session
Find an "if you need more support" page from every session
A case study and an embedded sample session on the portfolio site
